kind: portable derived verification record; not raw logs

browserRegression.command: ARCHIFY_EXPLAINER_BROWSER_TESTS=1 node scripts/run-tests.mjs --require-files '--test-name-pattern=dashed preview relationships|formal renderer retains keyboard' test/explainer-browser.test.mjs
browserRegression.behavior: Actual label/mask contrast >=4.5 and consistent label/path/marker ink; other variants/database palette/inline precedence/native child retained. No exact muted-token requirement.

baseDiscrimination.interpretation: Expected regression failure on base source with the same final test; washed-out dashed label.

focused.command: node scripts/run-tests.mjs --require-files test/explainer-diagrams.test.mjs test/explainer-renderer.test.mjs test/core-smoke.test.mjs test/generated-artifact-xml.test.mjs

firstFinalize.note: First finalize did not request the browser gate; the final explicit --browser-check execution is separately recorded and passed all four stages.

initialTestControlFailure.note: Initial test incorrectly equated dark database node stroke with the raw border token despite existing node-card color-mix. The control was corrected; production CSS did not change in response.

finalizeGate: See candidate-finalize-summary.json and archive-finalize-summary.json for real explicit-browser four-stage results; these are separate from the two browser regression cases.
scope: No full-repository suite, new global contrast gate, live installation or release.
